core.title: Diamond Tip Cabinet Pull Handle, Acorn IPKBP

text.description_html:
Acorn IPKBP, Diamond Tip Cabinet Handles

Acorn's Diamond Tip Cabinet Pull Handle would be at home in any rustic setting be it a cabin, a colonial period home, or even a country kitchen. This cabinet pull makes a statement. Its larger size makes it perfect for bigger doors like tall cabinets, large armoires, or closet doors. It is hand forged in the traditional way, using a hammer and anvil. Appearing as if it came straight from antiquity, the black iron finish mimics the look of naturally weathered iron.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Diamond Tip Cabinet Pull Handle:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 3/4"
  • Projection:1/3"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
